content:
Three people were hurt Saturday morning when a pickup truck was hit by a train in Jim Hogg County, according to KGNS, citing the Texas Department of Public Safety.

The collision happened at about 11:48 a.m. on Saturday, November 7, on Highway 359 near Reyna Ranch Road, DPS said.

According to DPS, the pickup was struck by the train, spun off into the opposite lane and then hit a second vehicle.

One person was thrown from the pickup, and two people were trapped inside it, KGNS reported. No deaths were reported, and the report did not describe the injuries further.

The injured people were taken to Jim Hogg Airport to wait to be airlifted for medical care, according to the report. No hospital was named, and no names or ages were released.

Sources: KGNS, November 7, 2026.
